messages:
Maya: Opening a docs PR to add a migration guide for Private -> Hybrid (VPC + on-prem fallback). Includes Terraform preflight snippet and a Go SDK token refresh example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Requesting review from eng-runtime and security.
Jordan: Nice — can you also add a short network preflight command for sealed sites? Eg check routing to control-plane and basic iptables/nftables sanity.
Maya: Yep. Planning to add `rwinference preflight --mode hybrid` + a tiny iptables check. Putting the snippets below.
Maya: ```bash
# quick preflight (example)
curl -fsS --retry 3 https://{{ REDWOOD_API_URL }}/v1/health || echo "control-plane unreachable"
# check NAT rules (sealed site)
sudo iptables -t nat -L || sudo nft list ruleset | head -n 20
```
Maya: Terraform example (minimal) + Go SDK token refresher snippet:```hcl
provider "rwinference" {
  endpoint = var.redwood_api_url
}
module "hybrid_migration" {
  source = "redwood/migrate/hybrid"
}
```
```go
// short Go SDK example showing simple refresh loop
client, _ := rwinference.NewClient(rwinference.Config{Endpoint: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_URL")})
ctx := context.Background()
// call that will transparently refresh tokens via configured refresh hook
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, rwinference.GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-small"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(string(resp.Text))
```
Jordan: For KMS/HSM section, include a note about PKCS#11 slot mapping and a suggestion to map logical keys to consistent slot IDs during migration.
Priya: Also add a short example mapping file and a pointer to the HSM compatibility matrix — I posted a link in the PR description: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/hsm-compat.md
Alex: docs-bot linkcheck flagged a couple of anchors and one 404. Also a nit: prefer `{{ REDWOOD_API_URL }}` placeholders in snippets rather than absolute prod URLs.
docs-bot: Linkcheck run results: /private/migrate#networking -> 404, suggested anchor: /private/migrate#networking-requirements. Ran at 2026-03-22T10:12Z.
Liam: I'll review later today. Quick ask — can you add a tiny troubleshooting checklist for "stuck on auth" (rotate key, check CA bundle, confirm PKCS#11 slot)?
Maya: Added troubleshooting checklist + example `sha256sum redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz` checksum note to the PR. PTAL @Liam @Alex. Also included a one-line example for air-gapped bundle verification.
Alex: Left two comments in the PR about wording; one small capitalization nit. After that LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — merging once Alex + Liam approve. Will follow up with a short release note in #eng-docs when merged. :rocket:
